item.title: Matthew Green: "I think we might lose public key cryptography"
item.description: Cryptographer Matthew Green argues AI advances in cryptanalysis could undermine standardized public-key cryptography long before quantum computers do — sparked by Anthropic Mythos' recent HAWK and reduced-round AES results.
